nodes.name: Sklearn Ensemble Bagging OOB Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic out-of-bag aggregation helpers for sklearn bagging classifier and regressor shells from supplied in-bag sample indices and already-computed estimator outputs.

nodes.name: bagging_classifier_oob_probability_totals
nodes.description: Accumulate sklearn BaggingClassifier out-of-bag class totals from supplied per-estimator probability outputs and in-bag sample indices.
nodes.type_signature: (probability_blocks: tuple[NDArray[np.float64], ...], class_index_blocks: tuple[NDArray[np.int64], ...], sample_index_blocks: tuple[NDArray[np.int64], ...], n_samples: int, n_classes: int) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function executes in constant time and space as it only performs simple validation checks, variable assignments, or returns inputs.

nodes.name: bagging_classifier_oob_vote_totals
nodes.description: Accumulate sklearn BaggingClassifier out-of-bag class totals from supplied vote-only predicted label indices and in-bag sample indices.
nodes.type_signature: (predicted_label_blocks: tuple[NDArray[np.int64], ...], sample_index_blocks: tuple[NDArray[np.int64], ...], n_samples: int, n_classes: int) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function performs linear-time element-wise array operations or copying over samples and features.

nodes.name: bagging_classifier_oob_decision_function
nodes.description: Normalize sklearn BaggingClassifier OOB class totals into the public OOB decision-function matrix, preserving NaNs for never-OOB samples.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function executes in constant time and space as it only performs simple validation checks, variable assignments, or returns inputs.

nodes.name: bagging_classifier_oob_label_indices
nodes.description: Choose sklearn BaggingClassifier's OOB argmax label indices from per-sample class totals.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function executes in constant time and space as it only performs simple validation checks, variable assignments, or returns inputs.

nodes.name: bagging_regressor_oob_predictions
nodes.description: Average sklearn BaggingRegressor out-of-bag predictions from supplied per-estimator outputs and in-bag sample indices, with the same zero-count safeguard used before OOB scoring.
nodes.type_signature: (prediction_blocks: tuple[NDArray[np.float64], ...], sample_index_blocks: tuple[NDArray[np.int64], ...], n_samples: int) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function performs linear-time element-wise array operations or copying over samples and features.
